_about: Local Ollama models for the Hermes agents of this repo (docs/AGENT_MODELS.md). Switch with env HERMES_MODEL or --model <tag>. Sizes, params and capabilities are from `ollama list` / `ollama show <tag>` on the machine that ran the comparison; the licence is the name printed by `ollama show <tag> --license`. Results are in examples/models_results.json.
selection: newest-generation small instruction models from distinct families that list tool support on their Ollama page (checked 2026-10-06), at most 3, plus the default as baseline

models.notes: Current default. The repo's prompts were tuned on it. Hermes <tool_call> format is native to it.
Newest generation; multimodal weights (vision, audio) are part of the 4.6 GB. Text only is used here.
Smallest candidate on disk; Ollama page lists tool use and structured JSON output.
Ollama (0.35.1) parses <tool_call> in the reply with its own Qwen parser; the Hermes JSON form made /api/chat return HTTP 500 in prompt mode (see docs/AGENT_MODELS.md).
